card.title: Greyoak House · The Closed Door
card.pitch: An old house at the blind end of Fog Lane. Three nights ago its master went in through this door and never came out. His niece has sent for you — one night, a butler who keeps his own counsel, and a house that will not talk.

cg.caption: The fog has crept all the way from the mouth of the lane to the steps of Greyoak House.
cg.camera: A slow push down Fog Lane, coming to rest on the stone steps before the house

cg.caption: “My uncle went in through this very door three nights ago. He never came out.”
cg.camera: Over the investigator's shoulder, pushing in on the butler in the lamp's shadow

cg.caption: The door upstairs stands ajar, and out in the back garden a loose board knocks, and knocks, in the wind.
cg.camera: Looking up the staircase from the hall, then panning across to the back corridor

prompts.player_portrait: The investigator (the player's default look): late twenties, gender indeterminate, a wide-brimmed hat pulled down over the eyes, a dark green long coat with the collar turned up, a dark scarf, brown leather gloves, a brass torch and a wooden walking stick. Head-and-shoulders, three-quarter front view, plain deep slate-blue background, {style}.

recipe.style: Anime illustration, clean line art, cel shading with two hard shadow tones, flat colour; a base of cold blue-grey (deep slate #1c2230, the grey-blue of fog #4a5568), the only warm colour the amber glow of an oil lamp (#e8a650), key light from the upper left and a cold rim light of fog on the right; a foggy night at an early-twentieth-century English manor; no text
